/**
 * This function sends a notification to the POS system via Firebase Cloud Messaging.
 * It retrieves the appropriate Firebase app instance based on the application name
 * and whether to use the legacy back office configuration.
 * Then, it gets the singleton instance of the POSNotifier and sends the notification message to all devices with their tokens.

export function sendPOS<T extends PushNotificationInput['type']>({
  params,
  useLegacyBackoffice,
}: {
  params: POSNotifierParams<T>
  useLegacyBackoffice: boolean
}) {
  const firebaseApp = getFirebaseKit(params.application, useLegacyBackoffice)
  const posNotifierInstance = POSNotifier.getInstance(firebaseApp)
  return posNotifierInstance.sendNotification(params.message)
}

import { RouteHandler } from 'fastify'

import BackOfficeHttpClient from '@pragma/http-client/legacy-backoffice'

import { FinalizeMigrationRouteGeneric } from './migrationFinalize.types'

export const finalizeDeviceMigrationHandler: RouteHandler<
  FinalizeMigrationRouteGeneric
> = async (req, reply) => {
  if (req.authClient.type !== 'device') {
    return reply.forbidden()
  }

  const processLegacyDataQueue = req.server.queues.processLegacyData

  const { locationId, legacyId, application } = req.authClient.identity

  if (!legacyId) {
    return reply.badRequest(
      'Missing legacyId in device identity, this establishment is a legacy-less one and cannot be migrated',
    )
  }

  const legacyBOHttpClientInstance = BackOfficeHttpClient.getInstance()
  await legacyBOHttpClientInstance
    .markEstablishmentAsMigrated(legacyId, application)
    .then(async (legacyData) => {
      req.log.info(
        {
          legacyData,
        },
        `Legacy data fetched for location ${locationId}`,
      )
      const job = await processLegacyDataQueue
        .add('processLegacyData', {
          locationId,
          legacyId,
          application,
          legacyData,
        })
        .catch(() => null)

      if (!job?.id)
        return reply.internalServerError(
          `Failed to add processLegacyData job for location ${locationId} with legacyId ${legacyId} and application ${application}`,
        )

      reply.code(201).send({
        id: job.id,
        jobName: job.name,
        queueName: job.queueName,
        timestamp: job.timestamp,
        payload: job.data,
      })
    })
    .catch(async (error) => {
      const errorMessage = `Error while fetching legacy data for location ${locationId} : ${
        error.message ?? error
      }`

      req.log.error(
        {
          error,
          application,
          legacyId,
          locationId,
        },
        errorMessage,
      )
      reply.internalServerError(errorMessage)
    })
}

import type { AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum } from '@pragma/common/shared'
import { db } from '@pragma/database/client'

import AccountingProviderApiHttpClient from '..'
import { env } from '../../../../env'
import { sendSlack } from '../../../notifier'

export const getAccountingProviderApiBaseUrl = (
  accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
) => {
  const accountingProviderApiUrls: Record<
    AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
    string
  > = {
    INEXWEB: env.INEXWEB_API_URL,
    FULLL: env.FULLL_API_URL,
  }
  return accountingProviderApiUrls[accountingProvider]
}

export const getAccountingProviderOAuthCredentials = (
  accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
) => {
  const accountingProviderOAuthCredentials: Record<
    AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
    { clientId: string; clientSecret: string }
  > = {
    INEXWEB: { clientId: env.INEXWEB_ID, clientSecret: env.INEXWEB_SECRET },
    FULLL: { clientId: env.FULLL_ID, clientSecret: env.FULLL_SECRET },
  }

  return accountingProviderOAuthCredentials[accountingProvider]
}

export const refreshAccessToken = async ({
  accountingProvider,
  accountId,
  refreshToken,
}: {
  accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum
  accountId: string
  refreshToken: string
}) => {
  const AccountingProviderApiHttpClientInstance =
    AccountingProviderApiHttpClient.getInstance()

  const tokens = await AccountingProviderApiHttpClientInstance.auth
    .refreshAuthorizationTokens(accountingProvider, { refreshToken })
    .catch((err) => {
      const message = `An error has occurred while refreshing the token for ${accountingProvider} for external service account ${accountId}: ${err.message}`
      sendSlack({
        text: message,
        icon_emoji: ':x:',
      })
      throw new Error(message)
    })

  const { access_token, refresh_token, expires_in } = tokens

  await db.externalServiceAccount
    .update({
      where: {
        id: accountId,
      },
      data: {
        refreshToken: refresh_token,
        accessToken: access_token,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + expires_in),
      },
    })
    .catch((err) => {
      const message = `An error has occurred while updating the token for ${accountingProvider} for external service account ${accountId} in database: ${err.message}`
      sendSlack({
        text: message,
        icon_emoji: ':x:',
      })
      throw new Error(message)
    })

import type { AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum } from '@pragma/common/shared'

import { FetchHttpClient } from '../../httpClient'
import {
  AccountingProviderAuthTokensType,
  AccountingProviderRequestConfigType,
  AccountsListResponse,
  InexwebAccountingBook,
  InexwebCompanies,
  InexwebCompanyPreferences,
  InexwebEntriesBody,
  InexwebEntriesResponse,
} from './helpers/types'
import { getAccountingProviderOAuthCredentials } from './helpers/utils'
import { accountingProviderAuthPlugin } from './plugins/auth.plugin'
import {
  AddEntriesParamsType,
  GetBooksParamsType,
  GetCompanyPreferencesParamsType,
} from './schemas/accounting/types'
import {
  AuthorizationTokensOutputType,
  GetAuthorizationTokensInputType,
  GetAuthorizationTokensParamsType,
  RefreshAuthorizationTokensInputType,
  RefreshAuthorizationTokensParamsType,
} from './schemas/auth/types'

export * from './helpers/types'

type AccountingProviderRequestOptions = {
  accountingProviderRequestConfig?: AccountingProviderRequestConfigType
}

export default class AccountingProviderApiHttpClient extends FetchHttpClient {
  private static instance: AccountingProviderApiHttpClient

  private constructor() {
    super({
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      plugins: [accountingProviderAuthPlugin],
    })
  }

  public static getInstance() {
    if (!this.instance) {
      this.instance = new AccountingProviderApiHttpClient()
    }

    return this.instance
  }

  auth = {
    getAuthorizationTokens: (
      accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
      params: GetAuthorizationTokensParamsType,
    ) => {
      const oAuthCredentials =
        getAccountingProviderOAuthCredentials(accountingProvider)

      return this.post<
        GetAuthorizationTokensInputType,
        AuthorizationTokensOutputType,
        AccountingProviderRequestOptions
      >(
        '/cred/oauth2/token',
        {
          grant_type: 'authorization_code',
          client_id: oAuthCredentials.clientId,
          client_secret: oAuthCredentials.clientSecret,
          code: params.oAuthCode,
        },
        {
          accountingProviderRequestConfig: {
            provider: accountingProvider,
          },
        },
      )
    },
    refreshAuthorizationTokens: async (
      accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
      params: RefreshAuthorizationTokensParamsType,
    ): Promise<AuthorizationTokensOutputType> => {
      const oAuthCredentials =
        getAccountingProviderOAuthCredentials(accountingProvider)
      return await this.post<
        RefreshAuthorizationTokensInputType,
        AuthorizationTokensOutputType,
        AccountingProviderRequestOptions
      >(
        '/cred/oauth2/token',
        {
          grant_type: 'refresh_token',
          client_id: oAuthCredentials.clientId,
          client_secret: oAuthCredentials.clientSecret,
          refresh_token: params.refreshToken,
        },
        {
          accountingProviderRequestConfig: {
            provider: accountingProvider,
          },
        },
      )
    },
  }

  accounting = {
    getBooks: async (
      accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
      params: GetBooksParamsType,
      authTokens: AccountingProviderAuthTokensType,
    ) => {
      return await this.get<
        InexwebAccountingBook[],
        {
          accountingProviderRequestConfig?: AccountingProviderRequestConfigType
        }
      >('/accounting/v1/books', {
        accountingProviderRequestConfig: {
          provider: accountingProvider,
          authTokens: authTokens,
          companyId: params.companyId,
        },
      }).catch((err) => {
        throw new Error(
          `An error has occurred while fetching books from ${accountingProvider} for external service account ${params.companyId}: ${err.message}`,
        )
      })
    },
    getCompanies: ({
      accountingProvider,
      query,
      authTokens,
    }: {
      accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum
      query?: string
      authTokens: AccountingProviderAuthTokensType
    }) => {
      const queryParam =
        !query || query.trim() === '' ? '' : `&q=${query.trim()}`
      return this.get<InexwebCompanies, AccountingProviderRequestOptions>(
        `/cred/v1/access/companies.json?page=1&max_per_page=1000&state=active&expand=corporate_name${queryParam}`,
        {
          accountingProviderRequestConfig: {
            provider: accountingProvider,
            authTokens: authTokens,
          },
        },
      )
    },
    getCompanyPreferences: (
      accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
      params: GetCompanyPreferencesParamsType,
      authTokens: AccountingProviderAuthTokensType,
    ) => {
      return this.get<
        InexwebCompanyPreferences,
        AccountingProviderRequestOptions
      >('/accounting/v1/preferences', {
        accountingProviderRequestConfig: {
          provider: accountingProvider,
          authTokens: authTokens,
          companyId: params.companyId,
        },
      })
    },
    getAccounts: (
      accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
      params: GetBooksParamsType,
      authTokens: AccountingProviderAuthTokensType,
      page = 1,
      limit?: number,
      accountClass?: 'C' | 'E' | 'F' | 'G',
    ) => {
      const baseUrl = '/accounting/v1/accounts'
      const queryParams = new URLSearchParams({
        complete_mode: '1',
        page: page.toString(),
        limit: limit?.toString() || '100',
        ...(accountClass && { account_class: accountClass }),
      }).toString()

      const url = `${baseUrl}?${queryParams}`

      return this.get<AccountsListResponse, AccountingProviderRequestOptions>(
        url,
        {
          accountingProviderRequestConfig: {
            provider: accountingProvider,
            authTokens: authTokens,
            companyId: params.companyId,
          },
        },
      )
    },
    addEntries: (
      accountingProvider: AccountingProviderWithOAuthEnum,
      params: AddEntriesParamsType,
      data: InexwebEntriesBody,
      authTokens: AccountingProviderAuthTokensType,
    ) => {
      return this.post<
        InexwebEntriesBody,
        InexwebEntriesResponse,
        AccountingProviderRequestOptions
      >('/accounting/v1/entries', data, {
        accountingProviderRequestConfig: {
          provider: accountingProvider,
          authTokens: authTokens,
          companyId: params.companyId,
        },
      })
    },
  }
}

import {
  RequestContext as BaseRequestContext,
  BetterFetchPlugin,
} from '@better-fetch/fetch'

import { AccountingProviderRequestConfigType } from '../helpers/types'
import {
  getAccountingProviderApiBaseUrl,
  refreshAccessToken,
} from '../helpers/utils'

type RequestContext = BaseRequestContext & {
  accountingProviderRequestConfig?: AccountingProviderRequestConfigType
  _retry?: boolean
}

type ResponseContext = {
  request: RequestContext
  response: Response
}

const refreshTokenPromises = new Map<string, Promise<string>>()

export const accountingProviderAuthPlugin: BetterFetchPlugin = {
  id: 'accounting-provider-auth',
  name: 'accounting-provider-auth',
  hooks: {
    onRequest: async (requestContext: RequestContext) => {
      const config = requestContext.accountingProviderRequestConfig

      if (!config) {
        throw new Error("AccountingProvider instance's config is missing")
      }

      const { provider, companyId, authTokens } = config

      requestContext.baseURL = getAccountingProviderApiBaseUrl(provider)

      if (authTokens?.accessToken) {
        requestContext.headers.set(
          'Authorization',
          `Bearer ${authTokens.accessToken}`,
        )
      }

      if (companyId) {
        requestContext.headers.set('X-Company', companyId.toString())
      }

      return requestContext
    },
    onResponse: async (context: ResponseContext) => {
      const request = context.request

      if (context.response.status !== 401 || request._retry) {
        return context.response
      }

      request._retry = true
      const config = request.accountingProviderRequestConfig

      if (!config?.authTokens?.accountId) {
        return context.response
      }

      const {
        provider,
        authTokens: { accountId, refreshToken },
      } = config

      let refreshPromise = refreshTokenPromises.get(accountId)

      if (!refreshPromise) {
        refreshPromise = refreshAccessToken({
          accountingProvider: provider,
          accountId,
          refreshToken,
        }).finally(() => {
          refreshTokenPromises.delete(accountId)
        })
        refreshTokenPromises.set(accountId, refreshPromise)
      }

      const newAccessToken = await refreshPromise

      const baseURL = getAccountingProviderApiBaseUrl(provider)
      config.authTokens.accessToken = newAccessToken

      const method = context.request.method
      const url = context.request.url.toString()

      const fullUrl = `${baseURL}${url}`

      const headers = new Headers()
      request.headers.forEach((value, key) => {
        headers.set(key, value)
      })
      headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${newAccessToken}`)

      const contextBody = request.body
      const body =
        contextBody && typeof contextBody === 'object'
          ? JSON.stringify(contextBody)
          : contextBody

      return await fetch(fullUrl, {
        method,
        headers,
        body,
      })
    },
  },
}

  private static instances: Map<string, UberEatsHttpClient> = new Map()

  private constructor(config: UberEatsHttpClientConfig) {
    super({
      baseURL: config.baseURL,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      schema: uberEatsSchema,
      ...getDefaultRetryOptions(),
    })

    this.config = config
    this.userAccessTokenPlugin = uberUserAccessTokenPlugin({
      tokenURL: this.config.tokenURL,
      locationId: this.config.locationId,
      clientId: this.config.clientId,
      clientSecret: this.config.clientSecret,
    })
    this.clientCredsTokenPlugin = uberClientCredsTokenPlugin({
      tokenURL: this.config.tokenURL,
      locationId: this.config.locationId,
      clientId: this.config.clientId,
      clientSecret: this.config.clientSecret,
    })
  }

  public static getInstance(
    config: UberEatsHttpClientConfig,
  ): UberEatsHttpClient {
    const existingInstance = this.instances.get(config.locationId)

    if (existingInstance) {
      return existingInstance
    }

    const newInstance = new UberEatsHttpClient(config)
    this.instances.set(config.locationId, newInstance)
    return newInstance
  }

  // -- POST TO GENERATE USER ACCESS TOKEN (OAUTH2 to access Uber POS endpoints)
  async userAccessToken({
    clientSecret,
    clientId,
    redirectUri,
    code,
    locationId,
  }: PostUserAccessTokenInput): Promise<
    ExternalServiceHttpClientResponse<PostTokenOutput>
  > {
    try {
      const form = new URLSearchParams()
      form.append('client_id', clientId)
      form.append('client_secret', clientSecret)
      form.append('grant_type', 'authorization_code')
      form.append('code', code)
      form.append('redirect_uri', redirectUri)

      const rawRes = await this.client('@post/', {
        body: form,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        baseURL: this.config.tokenURL,
      })

      const res = postUserAccessTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(rawRes)

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error.message)
      }

      const { access_token, token_type, expires_in, scope, refresh_token } =
        res.data

      const userAccessToken = {
        token: access_token,
        tokenType: token_type,
        tokenExpirationDate: new Date(
          Date.now() + expires_in * 1000,
        ).toISOString(),
        scopeList: scope.split(' '),
        refreshToken: refresh_token,
      }

      await updateUberUserAccessToken({
        locationId,
        userAccessToken,
      })

      return {
        data: userAccessToken,
        error: null,
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        error: {
          code: err?.status || 500,
          message: err.message,
          err,
        },
      }
    }
  }

import type { BetterFetchPlugin } from '@better-fetch/fetch'

import { retryWithBackoffDelay } from '@pragma/common/server'
import { retryIfRecoverablePrismaError } from '@pragma/database/helpers'

import { tokenPlugin } from '../../../../plugins/pluginToken'
import {
  postClientCredsTokenResponseSchema,
  updateUberClientCredsToken,
} from '../modules/auth'
import { getUserCredentials } from '../utils/get-user-credentials'
import { fetchUberTokens } from './utils/fetch-tokens'

// -- Get token method to pass to the token plugin
const getUberClientCredsToken =
  (locationId: string) => async (): Promise<string | null> => {
    // Retrieve tokens info from the database
    const { clientCredsToken } = await fetchUberTokens(locationId)
    if (!clientCredsToken) {
      return null
    }
    // Check if the token is expired
    const { token, tokenExpirationDate } = clientCredsToken
    if (new Date(tokenExpirationDate) < new Date()) {
      return null
    }
    return token
  }

// -- Renew token method to pass to the token plugin
const renewUberClientCredsToken =
  // Use closure to pass locationId, clientId and clientSecret
  (
    tokenURL: string,
    locationId: string,
    clientId: string,
    clientSecret: string,
  ) =>
    async (): Promise<string | null> => {
      try {
        const scopeList = [
          'eats.order',
          'eats.report',
          'eats.store',
          'eats.store.orders.read',
          'eats.store.status.write',
        ]

        // -- Request a new token
        const form = new URLSearchParams()
        form.append('client_id', clientId)
        form.append('client_secret', clientSecret)
        form.append('grant_type', 'client_credentials')
        form.append('scope', scopeList.join(' '))

        const newCreds = await getUserCredentials(tokenURL, form)
          .then((rawRes: { data: unknown }) => {
            const res = postClientCredsTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(
              rawRes.data,
            )

            if (!res.success) {
              throw new Error(res.error.message)
            }

            const { access_token, token_type, expires_in, scope } = res.data

            return {
              token: access_token,
              tokenType: token_type,
              tokenExpirationDate: new Date(
                Date.now() + expires_in * 1000,
              ).toISOString(),
              scopeList: scope.split(' '),
            }
          })
          .catch((err: unknown) => {
            console.error(
              `Error renewing token in uberClientCredsTokenPlugin: `,
              err,
            )
            throw err
          })

        // -- Call the update service with retry mechanism to store the new credentials. If it fails, notify and return null
        await retryWithBackoffDelay(
          async () =>
            await updateUberClientCredsToken({
              locationId,
              clientCredsToken: newCreds,
            }),
          null,
          {
            retry: retryIfRecoverablePrismaError,
          },
        ).catch((err) => {
          const errorMessage = `Location ${locationId}, error while renewing Uber Client Creds tokens. Error: ${err}`
          console.error(errorMessage)
          return null
        })

        console.info(
          `🛵 Location ${locationId}, Uber tokens renewed successfully 👌`,
        )
        return newCreds.token
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error renewing token in UberUserAccessPlugin: ', err)
        return null
      }
    }

// -- Export the plugin
export const uberClientCredsTokenPlugin = ({
  tokenURL,
  locationId,
  clientId,
  clientSecret,
}: {
  tokenURL: string
  locationId: string
  clientId: string
  clientSecret: string
}): BetterFetchPlugin =>
  tokenPlugin({
    pluginName: 'uberClientCredsTokenPlugin',
    getToken: getUberClientCredsToken(locationId),
    renewToken: renewUberClientCredsToken(
      tokenURL,
      locationId,
      clientId,
      clientSecret,
    ),
  })

/**
 * Shared convention for http-client `create(config)` factories.
 *
 * Background: see the singleton-bug postmortem at
 * `apps/knowledge/content/docs/(knowledge)/team-knowledge/post-mortem/2025-02-06_http-client-singleton-bugs.mdx`.
 * Singleton/cached instances (`getInstance()` backed by a static instance or
 * `Map`) allowed tenant-specific state (base URLs, tokens, credentials) to
 * leak across locations/tenants because the first caller's config "won" and
 * was silently reused by every subsequent caller.
 *
 * Convention going forward:
 * - Clients no longer expose `getInstance()`.
 * - Clients expose `static create(config)` which always returns a brand new,
 *   un-cached instance. No static `Map`, no shared singleton.
 * - `config` is an explicit object passed by the caller (never read from
 *   `process.env` inside the http-client package), so app-specific/tenant
 *   -specific values are owned by the calling application.
 * - `BaseHttpClientConfig` is the minimal shape (`{ baseURL: string }`).
 *   Clients that need more (tokens, OAuth credentials, appEnv, etc.) extend
 *   it, e.g. `type MyClientConfig = BaseHttpClientConfig & { token: string }`.
 *
 * See `UberEatsHttpClientConfig` in
 * `src/lib/clients/order-provider/uber-eats/HttpClient.ts` for a config shape
 * that extends this convention with additional OAuth fields.
 */
export type BaseHttpClientConfig = {
  baseURL: string

import {
  RequestContext as BaseRequestContext,
  BetterFetchPlugin,
} from '@better-fetch/fetch'

import { AccountingProviderRequestConfigType } from '../helpers/types'
import {
  getAccountingProviderApiBaseUrl,
  refreshAccessToken,
} from '../helpers/utils'

type RequestContext = BaseRequestContext & {
  accountingProviderRequestConfig?: AccountingProviderRequestConfigType
  _retry?: boolean
}

type ResponseContext = {
  request: RequestContext
  response: Response
}

const refreshTokenPromises = new Map<string, Promise<string>>()

export const accountingProviderAuthPlugin: BetterFetchPlugin = {
  id: 'accounting-provider-auth',
  name: 'accounting-provider-auth',
  hooks: {
    onRequest: async (requestContext: RequestContext) => {
      const config = requestContext.accountingProviderRequestConfig

      if (!config) {
        throw new Error("AccountingProvider instance's config is missing")
      }

      const { provider, companyId, authTokens } = config

      requestContext.baseURL = getAccountingProviderApiBaseUrl(provider)

      if (authTokens?.accessToken) {
        requestContext.headers.set(
          'Authorization',
          `Bearer ${authTokens.accessToken}`,
        )
      }

      if (companyId) {
        requestContext.headers.set('X-Company', companyId.toString())
      }

      return requestContext
    },
    onResponse: async (context: ResponseContext) => {
      const request = context.request

      if (context.response.status !== 401 || request._retry) {
        return context.response
      }

      request._retry = true
      const config = request.accountingProviderRequestConfig

      if (!config?.authTokens?.accountId) {
        return context.response
      }

      const {
        provider,
        authTokens: { accountId, refreshToken },
      } = config

      let refreshPromise = refreshTokenPromises.get(accountId)

      if (!refreshPromise) {
        refreshPromise = refreshAccessToken({
          accountingProvider: provider,
          accountId,
          refreshToken,
        }).finally(() => {
          refreshTokenPromises.delete(accountId)
        })
        refreshTokenPromises.set(accountId, refreshPromise)
      }

      const newAccessToken = await refreshPromise

      const baseURL = getAccountingProviderApiBaseUrl(provider)
      config.authTokens.accessToken = newAccessToken

      const method = context.request.method
      const url = context.request.url.toString()

      const fullUrl = `${baseURL}${url}`

      const headers = new Headers()
      request.headers.forEach((value, key) => {
        headers.set(key, value)
      })
      headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${newAccessToken}`)

      const contextBody = request.body
      const body =
        contextBody && typeof contextBody === 'object'
          ? JSON.stringify(contextBody)
          : contextBody

      return await fetch(fullUrl, {
        method,
        headers,
        body,
      })
    },
  },
}
